limitations: This is a transparent heuristic baseline, not a clinically validated triage rule.
A matched ASK replay uses the exact historical clinician question and its immediately adjacent patient reply; it does not claim to match a newly generated Base question.
The rule may select DEFER only when the live Expert service is available; historical clinician text is not returned as a model answer.
If Base confidence is available, use the frozen 0.35/0.65 thresholds; otherwise use only the missing-history fallback. Thresholds are not calibrated.
Do not tune this rule on evaluation outcomes.
